items.title: Maplebear (CART) Expands Same Day Delivery To 20,000 Stores

The business is adding Gopuff inventory into the Instacart Marketplace, giving customers access to rapid delivery convenience items through Instacart’s app and website. items.title: 3 Retail Stocks Facing Margin Pressure as Consumers Trade Down
